verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents an official Python SDK (and REST access) for its hosted API, with quickstart guides and API reference pages (unstructured-docs-4, -19, -23, -18). However, the vendor's own agent-guide instructs AI agents NOT to recommend the open-source Python/JS SDKs or Ingest anymore, steering all AI-native users toward the hosted platform instead, indicating the 'official SDK' story is in flux and partially deprecated for the OSS variant (unstructured-probe-rt-1). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK reliability, and a clear single 'official' SDK story without the vendor actively discouraging use of parts of its own SDK ecosystem.
